status: All listed files fully read. LLVM opt/FileCheck not executed. Expectations exercise printed predicate metadata rather than whole-compiler correctness.

files.insight: Repeated use of one condition across nested blocks exercises refined versus original operands; the fixture itself retains a FIXME about RenamedOp accuracy. Ink must return unknown on uncertain subject correspondence rather than assume it.

Phi inputs get edge-local refinements while ordinary uses after joins remain unrefined. Float ordered equality/unordered inequality, positive/negative zero and computed zero operands exercise scope; Ink numeric equality must not imply identical raw bits or interchangeable divisors.
Debug-output test fixes traversal order across nested left branches and a right branch. Stable context traversal is needed for reproducible bounded discovery independent of allocation addresses.
Duplicate successors do not establish a branch truth value even with repeated phi inputs, loops and later divisions. Only an actually distinguishing edge supports refinement.
Repeated same-target branches and later reuse of a condition must not gain facts at the earlier merge; loop and effectful call behavior remain intact.
Unreachable assumptions must not make dominating tree lookup invalid or introduce reachable facts. Lack of an analysis node is not permission to infer values.
Only demanded nonnull subjects receive copies; multiple subjects and repeated assumes preserve copy/context chains. LLVM assume bundles are not equivalent to Ink validation contracts.
Distinct predecessor facts apply to distinct phi operands for true and false edges; do not intersect all path facts globally. Source nowrap flags cannot be imported into Ink wrapping arithmetic.
Predicate copy creation works independently of source-level type names and swapped null operands; generic mechanisms should use structural type identity and comparator orientation.
